name: Alginet (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist blue with a white Agnus Dei on a yellow book, the fly red with a yellow tower.
history: The official flag of Alginet is of proportions 2:3, party per pale, the hoist half blue with the Agnus Dei of the arms and the fly half red with a yellow tower masoned and pierced black; it was approved by resolution of 18 January 2016 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 27 February 1995.

features.role: Agnus Dei with a banner lying on a book
